reels.name: 01_Obstacle_Course_Crash_Retry
reels.title: The Obstacle Course Crash and Retry
reels.reason: Shows the rider entering the stacked obstacle course, clipping the tire barriers, and getting back into another attempt.
reels.post_caption: One crash, then straight back into the obstacle course.

reels.name: 02_Hot_Wheels_Ramp_Jump
reels.title: A Huge Jump Across the Stunt Track
reels.reason: Builds speed on the elevated track, carries the bike into a high jump over the city, and includes the landing/fall aftermath.
reels.post_caption: The stunt track sends the bike soaring over Los Santos.

reels.name: 03_Ramp_Crash_Respawn
reels.title: The Ramp Jump Ends in a Crash
reels.reason: Shows the bike approaching the elevated section, losing the run in a crash, and continuing after respawn on a different bike.
reels.post_caption: The landing goes wrong, but the ride continues.

reels.name: 04_Tower_Jump_Fall_Recover
reels.title: The Tower Jump and Hard Landing
reels.reason: Captures the late tower-side jump, long fall through the city, impact, and recovery afterward.
reels.post_caption: One last launch turns into a long fall back to the streets.
